brn_walker.text: Rest and be thankful, it says on the stone. I rested. I am thankful. I would like to be thankful somewhere warmer.
The old military road goes up the hill in loops. Soldiers built it, and I think they built it that way on purpose to make us suffer less than they did.

brn_ranger.text: Ospreys nest round the loch in summer. If one drops a fish at your feet, it is a compliment. Do not argue.
The loch is about twenty-five miles long, the longest freshwater loch in Scotland, if you do not count the ones with monsters.

brn_hydro.text: There is a power station inside that mountain. Sixty years in there and it has never once been rained on.
Beannachd leibh, that is 'blessings with you', which is what we say when you leave and the lights are still on.

brn_historian.text: Some people say Bruce won the Pass of Brander without ever needing to fight the main force. I say he won it with a good map and a better ambush.
Nobody built a visitor centre, and I think that is the best compliment a battlefield can get.
